long_biography.plain_text:
Businessman Aleksei Migulin owns Grandmex outright and has served on its board since the Estonian company's establishment. The firm rented cars to private customers before expanding into residential development. It bought land in Tiskre for a housing project intended for sale. In 2025, it built fourteen terraced homes on the site.

He also became managing director of H2O Global when it was launched in Saint-Barthélemy in 2024. The company was established to trade boats, powered watercraft, diving equipment and other marine leisure products, and to offer boat charter and watersports.
